messages:
jordan.h: Heads-up — planning to bring 8x A500s into dedicated-west next Thu. Need vendor confirm on firmware/driver compatibility with our runtime and whether we can schedule a 2hr rack access window (Thu 10–12 PT). Also any power/cooling notes?

niko_rescale: We can support Thu 10–12. ETA for that SKU is 2026-06-03. Firmware v1.2.0 is the default we'll ship with, and recommended NVIDIA driver is 535.86. Power draw ~400W/GPU; plan for two 32A PDU feeds per rack. No special cooling beyond standard datacenter chill, but rack density will be higher than your current pools.

maya: Do we need to update the host image/kernel? Our prod runtime images currently use cuda-11.8 with kernel 5.15.

niko_rescale: cuda-11.8 + kernel 5.15 is supported. We'll pre-flash firmware 1.2.0 and run a quick compatibility check against your image. Can you share the image name/ID so we can pre-test in our lab?

jordan.h: image: redwood-prod-gpu-v3. Quick check command we use on nodes:

```
sudo nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv
```

Also — procurement needs to know customs risk. Is this shipping from EU or APAC? SOW needs signing by Monday.

own_leung: Vendor typically ships from the EU warehouse for that SKU. Transit 3–5 business days normally, but customs can add 2–4 days depending on HS code. If we need rack install onsite, we'll need customs docs sooner. @maya can you nudge finance for SOW?

maya: On it. Quick follow-up: if firmware v1.2.0 introduces any perf regressions, what rollback path do we have?

niko_rescale: We keep a backup firmware image and a rollback procedure. Rollback ~20 mins per node, can be done in parallel across the rack with our techs. We'll also run a perf smoke (latency + sample throughput) and share before/after logs. If you want, we can run the smoke against your image in our lab prior to ship.

jordan.h: That'd be great — please run pre-tests against redwood-prod-gpu-v3 and post the results. Also confirm whether PDUs need meters or remote power control for our automation.

niko_rescale: We'll test against the image and post results in this thread by EOD tomorrow. PDUs: recommend remote-capable PDUs (IPMI/snmp) for power cycling. We'll list exact models that fit your rack.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: dedicated-west rack access — Thu 2026-06-03 10:00–12:00 PT. Maintenance ID: MNT-20260603-12.

jordan.h: Nice — blocking calendar now. I'll also add a short checklist (pre-test results, spare power cables, customs docs, SOW signed). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
